_strategyNote: This is a Dataverse bound action with no payload. The 'contract' is: send empty body, expect 204 (or 200) on success. Known flakiness: freshly-created agents need a few seconds before the action is acceptable.
responseShape: HTTP 204 No Content (success) or HTTP 4xx with OData error envelope (failure)
lastVerifiedBy: Live verification via build-pipeline.stepPublish (retried 4x with backoff against freshly-created bots; success rate 100% when bot exists and instructions present)
knownQuirks: Freshly created agents can return HTTP 400 on first publish — the build-pipeline retries 4x with 5s / 5s / 10s / 15s backoff. Race condition with component materialization.
Publishing an agent with empty instructions succeeds but the agent is unusable in test chat. No warning — must verify via LSP pull after publish.
Publishing BEFORE calling POST /powervirtualagents/bots/{id}/api/botcomponents with Kind:['BotEntity'] succeeds but GptComponent is not materialized → empty agent.
Response body on success is empty (204). Response body on failure is OData error envelope: { error: { code, message } }.
nonContractualFields: Response timing — varies with tenant load, usually <2s but can be 30s+

errorCases.reason: Bot does not exist or publish preconditions unmet
User lacks publish permission on target env
Bot GUID not found in target env
